notes.title: We are building a New Game
notes.content:
Hi everybody,

we are excited to announce that we are developing a new PC game.
It is an open-world Survival Building RPG set in ancient Greece.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42667586/c510fab8a7f259c3f7b07a11f75ac27664b97f35.png

Main features:

 617.76sq miles Open-World Greece replica map
 10 Biomes - 10 Bosses
 34 Minion Enemies & Wild Animals
 Dynamic Weather per Biome (unique atmosphere)
 Single-player & Multi-player (up to 10 players)
 45 Weapons , 12 Shields , 54 Armor Pieces
 Modular Building with snap (you can build your own structures)
 Crafting (weapons , equipment , furniture , tools , etc.)
 Cooking 
 Sailing
 Sleeping
 Farming
 ...and many more


Check it our here > https://store.steampowered.com/app/2108370/Argonisos/

Cheers!
